model.name: Normal reading
model.message: The reading of 8.34 bar is within the normal operating range.

model.message: The reading has been logged and a medium‑priority work order held due to a rising temperature drift of 2.7 °C per day over the past week.

model.name: Filter pressure drop over limit
model.message: The gauge reading indicates a high differential pressure across filter F‑1 (1.44 bar > 1.2 bar limit), so a maintenance work order has been held for supervisor review.

model.message: The gauge reading of 145.6 psi exceeds the alarm high limit of 140 psi, so a high‑priority work order has been held for supervisor review.
